description:
Lydon Farrell Property are delighted to present 4 Oliver Plunkett Road, Kells which is a 3 bedroom semi-detached house with a separate garage and a large back garden. The existing layout is ideal with a good open plan design which provides a kitchen and dining space at the rear and then there sliding doors which leads to a large sitting room at the front. The property is located within the town centre off the Moynalty Road, within immediate proximity to Super Valu, Aldi, Bus Eireann Bus Stop, numerous schools and general good town centre amenities. There is multiple recreational; educational options with preschools, creches, primary and secondary schools; employment and other facilities. All of these important amenities along with excellent public transport are within walking distance.

The ground floor features a porch, entrance hallway, living room to the front and a open plan kitchen/ dining area to the rear along with a utility room. The first floor comprises of three bright bedrooms and a family bathroom. The property benefits from a detached garage to the rear and a driveway providing off street parking. The house has been well maintained by the current owners and it is worth noting that the views to the rear of the property are really stunning.

With the M3 Motorway adjacent and the N52 (Dundalk/Limerick Road) close by, Kells is one of the stronger satellite towns ideal for those commuting to Dublin and elsewhere. Regular buses run along the M3/N3 through the town adding to the choice of travel options to Dublin city and airport. Employees from the ICT, E-commerce and pharma sectors based around Blanchardstown / Damastown as well as ICTs based around Leixlip often choose Kells as a place to call home, citing lifestyle, ease of commuting and affordability as the rational for their choice. Such companies include giants like Synopsys, IBM, PayPal, Symantec, Ebay, Paypal, Bristol Myers-Squibb, Alexion, Helsinn Birex, Hewlett-Packard and Intel with recent additions to include MSD (formerly Takeda and previously Shire), near Dunboyne and Facebooks data centre at Clonee.

Viewings by appointment only.
